costs.candidate_construction_scope: Common full TRAIN preparation + common E Gram setup + endpoint method + own finite path + selected model serialization. This excludes other experimental arms, source bookkeeping and all held-out evaluation; it is not an end-to-end training speedup.
costs.policy_timing_scope: Measured Python decision blocks, each arm/world has cold features; J planning above is additional, and evaluator timings also include shared truth diagnostics. Not production latency or an equal-hardware neural-throughput benchmark.

posthoc_diagnostic.caveat: This explains fixed policies on the already exposed48 worlds; it is not new holdout evidence, a causal intervention on individual weights, a general law-error theorem or a repaired candidate.

example.rule: Smallest-index TEST world attaining the minimum already-frozen E-minus-C expected utility among all32 existing fit23 OOD TEST worlds; all48 records remain available.

proxy_scope: Descriptive F64 quadratic identity, not an independent exact loss certificate

holdout_replay.scope: separate recursive evaluator and literal stored-head reductions; frozen core/law definitions shared

train_replay.scope: original pinned recursive execution, not the new complete-state DAG implementation

visitation_scope: Every arm's task/diagnostic metrics are under its own policy visitation distribution; differences do not isolate same-state calibration.
